package.name: chrono_fmu_dynamics_node
package.description: Generic FMU-wrapped dynamics node, shared by both the split (스플릿 버전) and distributed (분산 버전) ros2_control tracks: subscribes Bridge 2's VehicleCommand, publishes VehicleStatus, wraps fmu_client the same way ChronoFmuSystemInterface does, just as a plain node instead of a hardware_interface plugin. No control logic and no knowledge of which track's upstream node/plugin is talking to it -- see ../../README.md.
